mcqs.question: India’s first National Household Travel Survey, conducted during July 2025–June 2026, was carried out by which organisation?
options: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
mcqs.explanation: India’s first National Household Travel Survey was conducted by the National Statistical Office (NSO) under MoSPI. MoSPI is the ministry associated with NSO, while CSO and NSSO were the organisations merged to form NSO in 2019.
